scope: Native AppModel, separate synthetic data directory, nonactivating window. Network interruptions injected at the URLSession boundary. No user recordings, cloud ASR, microphone input or changes to system network settings.
regressions: Old A→B→A availability callbacks cannot dismiss the current model.
Fallback may be explicitly pinned and a failed sole local recognizer retried. Removing a pin restores the default.

Only connectivity errors arm a retry. Duplicate satisfied events do not repeat a transfer. A restoration racing with URLSession completion is retained. User cancellation removes the pending resumption.
Data integrity or server reply failures do not arm network retries. Deletion clears the saved interruption.
not_run: Disconnecting or reconnecting the host network or recording a private microphone session.
